newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan should not intervene in stock prices -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan should not intervene in stock prices -- MOF.

text.p: Japan's Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Thursday that the government should not try to influence stock market prices.

"We would be interfering in autonomous decision-making if the government intervened in the stock market...Ask the market about what is happening in the market," Mitsuzuka told a key budget committee of the Upper House of parliament.
The minister said he would be open to messages from the stock market, but added that this was the basic stance the government must maintain.
"The stock market seems to have become generally stable in the past three to four days. We will certainly watch with great interest should prices fluctuate wildly," Mitsuzuka said.
